<script>
  (function () {
    const root = document.documentElement;
    const update = () => {
      root.style.setProperty("--bg-scroll-y", window.scrollY + "px");
      // For aligning the stretched background across fixed elements
      root.style.setProperty("--bg-doc-h", document.body.scrollHeight + "px");
    };
    update();
    window.addEventListener("scroll", update, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener("resize", update, { passive: true });

    const nav = document.querySelector(".top-nav");
    const toggle = document.querySelector(".top-nav .nav-toggle");
    const menu = document.querySelector(".mobile-nav-links");
    if (nav && toggle && menu) {
      const close = () => {
        menu.classList.remove("is-open");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
      };
      toggle.addEventListener("click", () => {
        const open = menu.classList.toggle("is-open");
        toggle.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
      });
      menu.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (e.target && e.target.closest("a")) close();
      });
      document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
        if (!nav.contains(e.target) && !menu.contains(e.target)) close();
      });
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.key === "Escape") close();
      });
    }
  })();
</script>

<h2 id="about">About Me</h2>

I am a second-year PhD student in Electrical and Computer Engineering at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), advised by Professor [Minh N. Do](https://ece.illinois.edu/about/directory/faculty/minhdo). I am also fortunate to work closely with Professor [Ge Liu](https://www.mit.edu/~geliu/). Before joining UIUC, I received my B.Sc. in Mathematics from the University of Hong Kong.

<h2 id="research-interests">Research Interests</h2>

<p>
My research lies at the intersection of <span class="topic-tag topic-mm">Multimodal Representation Learning</span>, <span class="topic-tag topic-gen">Generative Modeling</span>, <span class="topic-tag topic-robot">Robotics</span>, and <span class="topic-tag topic-health">AI for Healthcare and Biomedicine</span>.
</p>

<p>
I aim to build <strong>theoretically grounded and scalable learning frameworks</strong> for multimodal intelligence. In <strong>multimodal representation learning</strong>, I explore new perspectives and principled objectives that capture structure both across and within modalities. In <strong>generative modeling</strong>, I focus on making generation both <strong>efficient and controllable</strong>.
</p>

<p>
More broadly, I view representation and generation as complementary facets of intelligence, and I seek <strong>unified learning paradigms</strong> in which each informs the other across modalities. I am particularly interested in how the capacities to <strong>perceive, understand, reason, predict, generate, and act</strong> can develop together and reinforce one another—giving rise to systems that learn from their own experience and continually improve through interaction with the world.
</p>
